title: PATCH /users/{id} – request
description: Change the given properties of a user; active: false deactivates (an inactive user cannot log in). e-mail and password only for a supervisor. The role cannot change. The PIN changes with PUT /users/{id}/pin. Only for a user every site of whom is a site of the caller (otherwise 403 forbidden: a supervisor of one shared site must not take over the account of a colleague who also manages other sites); a user changes their own e-mail address, password and PIN. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 200, api/user.response.json.

password.description: Password of the supervisor for POST /auth/login.
